description:
=== DONE (s473t5d) ===
FOUND + FIXED s473t5d (Opus, 2026-09-13) by #1501 round 5 (run/ + io/ CHECK 1).

t/io/tell.t stopped at its 27th row with

  The path #P".../t/>/tmp/pcl-test-N-N" does not exist.

`%p-open-parse-2arg`'s mode table had ">>", "+<", "+>", "|-", "-|", ">", "<" and
NO "+>>", so `open($tst,"+>>$written")` matched the two-character "+>" arm and
the remaining ">" stayed on the FILENAME -- PCL then opened, relative to the
cwd, a file literally named ">/tmp/pcl-test-...".

FIVE sites, all of them (rule 11 -- the mode is one closed set read in five
places):
  %p-open-parse-2arg       the 2-arg splitter (longest-first, before "+>")
  %p-open-impl             the plain-file dispatch (:direction :io
                           :if-exists :append :if-does-not-exist :create)
  %p-open-anon-temp-direction  the `undef` anonymous-temporary direction map
  %p-input-mode-p          the `use open IN => ...` half
  %p-open-memory           the in-memory (\$scalar) dispatch

PERL'S SEMANTICS, probed 5.40.3 over twelve shapes (the guard is the probe):
  an EXISTING file is not truncated and tell() is its size;
  a seek makes it readable;
  a write goes to the END whatever the position says (O_APPEND) -- so
    `print; seek(0,0); print "X"` leaves the X at the end;
  a NEW file is created, tell() 0;
  in-memory: tell() = length, and a print appends;
  `open $fh,"+>>",undef` (the anonymous temporary) works.

RESULT: t/io/tell.t 26/0 DIFF -> 36/0 OK, and its 10 blessed fail rows +
10 shortfall rows left the baselines by EDIT.  t/io/perlio_open.t's
`open my $fh, '+>>', undef` row went with it.

Guard Pl/t/open-modes-01.t rows 1+2 (6/6 rows FAIL on a `git archive 2ff53f8d`
extraction).  No emission change.
subject: the "+>>" (read/append) open mode was missing from every dispatch site, so the shorter "+>" arm won and left the second ">" on the FILENAME
